request.description: Read-only audit trail, newest first (Settings → سجل التدقيق).
«نسيت كلمة المرور؟»: username + the account's reference email + a new password (reception PC, offline).
First run: create the first manager when the reception PC has no users (login screen «إعداد النظام»).
Active users for the login screen's picker (names and roles only).
1.1: a new PC opens a hotel from a backup, when the owner chooses to — view only or work on it.
«ربط حساب» (manager): opens Google's consent page; Google returns to ``…/drive/callback``.
«مزامنة مع Drive»: reception uploads pending backups; the owner PC downloads newer ones.
«فصل الحساب» (manager).
«نسخة احتياطية الآن» (artboard 6.13): writes the encrypted file now; the result line shows it.
«سجل التشغيل»: backup runs, newest first.
Everyone signed in reads the accepted currencies (payment dialogs); only the owner adds one.
